profiles.prompt_brief: Generate an audio effect that processes its input. The process must accept one or two audio inputs and produce one or two bounded audio outputs.

Generate a LIVE-INPUT granular texture effect, not a sample player. Build grains from bounded delay lines fed by the incoming audio. Expose Grain Size, Density, Position or Delay, Pitch or Spray, Feedback, and Mix controls.
Generate a playable synthesized instrument voice following the required gate, freq or key, and gain or velocity voice contract.

Generate a procedural one-shot percussion voice with no soundfile dependency. Follow the required gate, freq or key, and gain or velocity voice contract; each trigger must have a clear transient and bounded decay.
Generate a self-running bounded sound generator or drone. It must take zero audio inputs and produce audio without requiring MIDI gate, pitch, or velocity controls.

_synth_override_comment: A prompt can ask for generator-family language (drone, generative, ...)
AND explicit playable-instrument language ('a generative synth') in the
same breath. The generator family's own contract above requires NO
gate/freq/pitch/velocity controls -- before this override existed, Auto
silently produced an unplayable 'synth' whenever a generator term won the
match, with nothing telling the user their prompt got rerouted away from
a playable instrument. Any profile with 'overridden_by_synth_terms': true
defers to the instrument default (currently 'synth') when the prompt ALSO
contains one of these terms. Consumed identically by
one canonical list, not two hand-synced copies.
